name: The Narrows Retreat
tradition: Kriya Yoga, Paramhansa Yogananda lineage, via Ananda Sangha Worldwide
retreatOptions: 3-hour sessions; 5-day/4-night immersion; periodic group weekend retreats
about: A small, boutique Yogananda-lineage retreat run from a teacher's home property near Hamilton. Meditation and Kriya Yoga instruction are central rather than incidental; scale is modest compared to larger Ananda communities abroad, but it is a genuine dedicated New Zealand property with residential programming.
schedule: Ad hoc immersions plus periodic group weekends
cost: NZD 2,850 for a 5-day/4-night immersion including meals and one-on-one instruction

pricePerDay.notes: $2,850 / 5-day-4-night immersion, includes meals and one-on-one instruction.
